Built with current systems

Samples that explain the pipeline.

The shipped Sandbox is both a visual test scene and an honest reference project: basic assets first, advanced graphs and effects after the foundations are clear.

S

Kéire Sandbox

A complete project with organized scenes, prefabs, scripts, input, audio, materials, shaders, VFX, and reproducible validation content.

G

Shader + Material Lab

Custom shader graphs define reusable shading interfaces; material graphs bind textures, values, functions, and instances to them.

V

VFX Starter Effects

CPU and GPU effects demonstrate spawn contexts, events, attributes, outputs, bounds, diagnostics, and performance budgets.

C#

Gameplay foundations

Small managed behaviours show lifecycle, serialized fields, component access, input, events, reloading, and player builds.

KéireENGINE

Open game technology built around explicit ownership, observable systems, and boring reliability.
